description: A utility class providing static helper methods for parsing TypeScript code, focusing on whitespace normalization and identifier character checks.

classes.name: TypeScriptUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for handling TypeScript parsing tasks, such as whitespace normalization and identifier character validation.

methods.name: NormalizeSpaces
methods.description: Replaces sequences of whitespace characters in the input string with a single space and trims leading and trailing whitespace.

methods.name: IsIdentifierStart
methods.description: Checks if a character is a valid starting character for a TypeScript identifier (letter, underscore, or dollar sign).

methods.name: IsIdentifierPart
methods.description: Checks if a character is a valid part of a TypeScript identifier (letter, digit, underscore, or dollar sign).
